* fix(Toggle): submit a pressed Toggle with its form

The hidden checkbox never received `checked`, so a named Toggle was
always left out of the form data. Bind `checked` and `disabled` as
Checkbox, Switch and Radio do, so a pressed Toggle submits "true" and
a disabled one is left out.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(VisuallyHidden): bubble form events after the hidden input updates

The hidden input dispatched input/change before Vue patched it, so a form
change handler read the previous state. It also wrote a checkbox's checked
state into its value, so a Checkbox submitted "true" instead of its
`value` after the first toggle. Dispatch post-flush, and set `checked` on
checkable inputs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(Toggle,VisuallyHidden): submit the right form value and bubble events after update (#3097)

* fix(Toggle): submit a pressed Toggle with its form

The hidden checkbox never received `checked`, so a named Toggle was
always left out of the form data. Bind `checked` and `disabled` as
Checkbox, Switch and Radio do, so a pressed Toggle submits "true" and
a disabled one is left out.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(VisuallyHidden): bubble form events after the hidden input updates

The hidden input dispatched input/change before Vue patched it, so a form
change handler read the previous state. It also wrote a checkbox's checked
state into its value, so a Checkbox submitted "true" instead of its
`value` after the first toggle. Dispatch post-flush, and set `checked` on
checkable inputs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
